name: Village
description: Small settlements where heroes can recruit basic units and rest.

interactions.name: Recruit Unit
interactions.description: Recruit a Regular Unit from the Unit Offer. Cost is modified by Reputation.

interactions.name: Plunder
interactions.description: Raid the village for resources. Damages your reputation.

rules: Cannot recruit if Reputation is X (-5)

name: Monastery
description: Sacred places where heroes can learn Advanced Actions and heal.

interactions.name: Recruit Unit
interactions.description: Recruit a Regular Unit from the Unit Offer.

interactions.name: Heal
interactions.description: Pay 2 Influence to heal 1 Wound. Monasteries offer cheaper healing.

interactions.name: Training
interactions.description: Pay 6 Influence to gain an Advanced Action card from the offer.
interactions.note: The Advanced Action card is placed in the Unit Offer slot for this monastery.

interactions.name: Burn Monastery
interactions.description: Attack the monastery defenders. Gain an Artifact but lose 2 Reputation.

rules: Each monastery has one Advanced Action card in the Unit Offer
Burning a monastery removes the Advanced Action from the offer

name: Mage Tower
description: Towers where heroes can learn Spells and recruit spellcaster units.

interactions.name: Recruit Unit
interactions.description: Recruit a Unit from the Unit Offer (spellcasters preferred).

interactions.name: Learn Spell
interactions.description: Pay 7 Influence + 1 Mana of any color to learn a Spell from the Spell Offer.

assault.description: Attack the tower. Defeat Violet enemies to conquer.

rules: Fortified site - Siege attacks required in Ranged phase
When conquered, provides shelter and recruiting

name: Keep
description: Fortified strongholds. Must be conquered before using.

interactions.name: Recruit Unit
interactions.description: Recruit Regular Units from the Unit Offer when you control this Keep.

assault.reward: Control of keep, 1 Fame per defender level
assault.description: Attack the keep. Defeat Grey enemies to conquer.

rules: Fortified site - Siege attacks required in Ranged phase
Other players entering your occupied Keep triggers PvP

name: City
description: Major urban centers. Cities are the main objectives in many scenarios.

assault.reward: Control of city, Fame based on defenders
assault.description: Attack the city. Defeat White enemies based on city level.

interactions_when_conquered.name: Recruit Any Unit
interactions_when_conquered.description: Recruit any type of Unit from the Unit Offer.

interactions_when_conquered.name: Buy Fame
interactions_when_conquered.description: The city leader can spend 2 Influence to gain 1 Fame.

interactions_when_conquered.name: Learn Spell
interactions_when_conquered.description: Learn a Spell from the Spell Offer.

rules: Fortified site - no Ranged attacks against defenders
City level determines number of defenders
First player to conquer becomes Leader
Other players may co-occupy but Leader gets Fame benefits

name: Magical Glade
description: Mystical clearings with healing and mana properties.

interactions.name: Empower
interactions.description: Absorb magical energy. Different effects Day/Night.

interactions.name: Cleanse
interactions.description: Discard Wound cards from your hand. For each, gain 1 Mana token of any color.
interactions.note: Wounds go to Wound pile, not your discard

name: Crystal Mine
description: Mines that produce crystals of a specific color.

interactions.name: Harvest Crystals
interactions.description: Gain 1 Crystal of the mine's color to your Inventory.

rules: Crystal color is determined by mine variant

name: Dungeon
description: Underground lairs filled with monsters and treasure.

combat.description: Fight using Night combat rules regardless of actual time.

reward.description: Draw 2 Artifacts, keep 1, put other at bottom of deck.

rules: Night rules: Black mana available, Gold mana unavailable
Must defeat all enemies to claim reward

name: Tomb
description: Ancient burial sites guarded by powerful creatures.

combat.description: Fight a Draconum using Night combat rules.

reward.description: Gain 1 Artifact AND 1 Spell from their respective offers.

name: Spawning Grounds
description: Breeding grounds for monsters. More dangerous than dens.

reward.description: Draw 2 Artifacts, keep 1, put other at bottom of deck.

rules: Must fight both enemies at once

name: Ancient Ruins

combat.description: Draw a Ruins token to determine encounter.

reward.description: Reward depends on drawn token. May be loot or combat.

rules: Token determines if combat or immediate loot
Combat tokens specify enemies to fight

name: Draconum Lair
rules: Moving between adjacent spaces provokes attack

name: Marauding Orcs
description: Orc war parties roaming the land.

reward.description: Gain 2 bonus Fame (in addition to enemy Fame).

rules: Moving between adjacent spaces provokes attack
